changelog: - **An observation view for watching a run.** The run row's Observation view button, or View ▸ Observation view, hides both side panels and the tool row so the canvas and the Timeline take the window; the run keeps playing, the zoom stays and the part of the model at the centre stays at the centre. A second press, Esc or a panel button in the status bar brings the panels, the tool row and the canvas position back exactly. Where the run row is short, as at 900 px with the properties panel open, the button gives way and View ▸ Observation view stays. Not on the phone.
